We were at home last night
Como foi o seu fim de semana?
Ela não estava no trabalho ontem.

texto.titulo: Last weekend / No fim de semana passado
texto.ru: Last weekend was great. On Saturday we were at my cousin's wedding. The church was beautiful and the music was lovely. We were very happy, but my feet were tired after the party! On Sunday I wasn't at home in the morning because I was at the market. The weather was cold and the streets were empty. In the afternoon my friends were with me and we were all hungry, so we had pizza.
texto.pt: O último fim de semana foi ótimo. No sábado estivemos no casamento do meu primo. A igreja estava linda e a música era agradável. Estávamos muito felizes, mas meus pés estavam cansados depois da festa! No domingo eu não estava em casa de manhã, porque estava no mercado. O tempo estava frio e as ruas estavam vazias. À tarde meus amigos estavam comigo e todos estávamos com fome, então comemos pizza.

perguntas.pergunta: Was the weather warm on Sunday?
